'''Basile''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. During [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], Basile served aboard the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']] as second in command to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tohri Challon]]. Basile perished alongside the crew of the ''Dauntless'' in a successful attempt to buy time for the Emperor's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], ''[[Defender One]]'', to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Legacy 46" />
